name: Confluence of the Chuya and Katun
full: Confluence of the Chuya and Katun rivers (Altai: Chuy-Oozy — “mouth of the Chuya”), km 712–714 of the Chuysky Trakt (R256 highway), between the villages of Inya and Iodro, at the turn-off to Inegen
near: Inya village (≈7 km, km 703), Inegen village (beyond the bridge over the Katun), Iodro village
elev: The exact elevation of the confluence was not found; a guide point is Inegen village ≈6 km upstream on the Katun: 750 m (Znanie); the viewing terrace is ≈120 m above the water (Great Russian Encyclopedia)
short: The place where the muddy-white Chuya flows into the turquoise Katun: two colours of water run side by side against a backdrop of cliffs and river terraces; a sacred place of the Altai people right by the highway.
desc: Chuy-Oozy is the mouth of the Chuya, where it flows into the Katun at km 712–714 of the Chuysky Trakt (R256 highway), about 7 km beyond the village of Inya. The Katun, flowing from the Belukha glaciers, is turquoise-green here, while the Chuya, which collects water from high-mountain steppes and clayey banks, is murky, milky-grey; at the line of the confluence the two streams run side by side for a while without mixing. The contrast is best seen from late July and especially in autumn, when the Katun finally clears of the silt from meltwater; in early summer both rivers may be muddy. The valley is formed by a system of up to 23 river terraces of different heights (210–230 m, 80–100 m, 3–8 m); the area was proposed as a geomorphological natural monument, “Mouth of the Chuya River” (110 ha). In 2002 the Chuy-Oozy nature park was created here (810 ha — the smallest in the republic, >400 species of flowering plants), and by 2011 it had lost its status. On the right bank of the Chuya there are the Ak-Uzyuk/“Chuy-Oozy” petroglyphs (8th–7th centuries BC), a tourist complex with a guesthouse and café, and 8–10 km upstream on the Chuya the Kalbak-Tash sanctuary. By the viewing area there is a gazebo where souvenirs are sold; opposite stands the Baatyr-Tash rock, in whose outline people see the head of a hero and a horse. For the Altai people this is a sacred place: people don't make noise or litter here.
guide: Come here in August–September: in summer the Katun is still muddy, and instead of two colours you'll see “one dirty river and another a bit cleaner” — as disappointed bloggers honestly put it. Look opposite for the Baatyr-Tash rock — you can make out a hero's head and a horse in it. There is a legend about the “camel's neck” (Kyyo-Moyn): a man survived a deadly hailstorm by sheltering in a camel's carcass. For a better angle, cross the bridge towards Inegen — from the second viewpoint you can see how the Chuya “pours” into the Katun. This is a place of power for the Altai people: speak quietly and don't throw anything into the water.
see: The two-colour confluence from the roadside viewing area; the second viewpoint by the road to Inegen (across the bridge over the Katun); the Baatyr-Tash rock; river terraces; the Ak-Uzyuk/Chuy-Oozy petroglyphs by the highway; the ovoo (cairn) and dyalama ribbons by the gazebo; the Inya (Tsaplin) suspension bridge of 1936 in Inya.
skip: You're going in June or early July and have already seen the confluence in photos: during the flood both rivers are muddy and there is almost no effect. But the stop takes 15 minutes — on the way to Kalbak-Tash it is worth getting out anyway.
diff: Very easy: a viewing area by the highway
when: From late July to October (the Katun clears, turquoise colour); in autumn — yellow larches. June–July — flood, weaker contrast.
daytime: The second half of the day and sunset — the best light according to 2GIS reviews; in the morning soft light (Inegen blog)
how: Along the Chuysky Trakt to km 712: ≈273 km from Gorno-Altaysk, ≈365 km from Biysk, ≈530 km from Barnaul, ≈714 km from Novosibirsk; ≈78 km from Ongudai. The Gorno-Altaysk — Kosh-Agach marshrutka (minibus) (09:00) goes past — ask to be dropped off at the confluence; on the way back, catch a passing service/taxi from Inya.
roadtype: Paved R-256; to Inegen — a bridge over the Katun and a local road
traveltime: ≈4–4.5 h from Gorno-Altaysk; ≈1 h 15 min from Ongudai
stay: Inya: Chetyre Bogatyrya (from 3,000 ₽), Alkyshtu in Malaya Inya (from 4,000 ₽), My Yuta (from 15,000 ₽) — per 2GIS 2026; Inegen agro-complex by the Katun; the guesthouse of the Chuy-Oozy complex; Maly Yaloman (≈15–20 km to the confluence): Baykan on the Katun bank (from 3,000 ₽, 5.0/133), Baylyk (from 2,500 ₽), Ail (km 697, from 2,500 ₽), Kan Kerede (from 3,000 ₽) — 2GIS 2026
net: MTS gets a signal at the viewing area (2GIS review); other operators — not found
transfer: Group excursions 8,000–12,900 ₽/person; private ones 27,965–45,080 ₽ per vehicle (2026)
bring: A windbreaker, sun protection, cash for souvenirs
warn: Be careful at the edges of the terraces and by the water, especially after rain and in winter. Do not swim — strong current, icy water. The café of the Chuy-Oozy complex was previously closed by a court for sanitary violations (welcometoaltai) — check reviews. R-256 repairs in 2026: in the Altai Republic km 439–444 (Maima) and 560–570 (exit from Shebalino) have been repaired; until the end of 2026 work is under way at km 455–472 (Souzga–Manzherok) and 479–495 (Izvestkovy–Barangol) — lane narrowing and alternating traffic are possible (Tolk, 06.10.2026). In 2026–2029 — reconstruction of 18 km at Souzga–Manzherok with detours (Tolk, 24.03.2026). On 01.10.2026 a rockfall onto the highway with no injuries was reported (NGS22; location not specified). The highway is periodically closed for military convoys. There is no border zone (Ongudai district). Ticks: according to Rospotrebnadzor for the Altai Republic, by 25.08.2026 there were 3,600 reports of tick bites and 22 cases of tick-borne encephalitis (the Ongudai district is among the districts with bites). Card terminals in the villages work unreliably — bring cash (OneTwoTrip, 10.2024).
food: At the viewing area there are kiosks: cheese flatbreads, yak and maral (Altai red deer) chebureks (cheese cheburek ≈250 ₽), manty, belyashi; teas and halva (2GIS reviews, 2025). Chuy-Oozy café (Chuyozy village, 1 G. M. Toptygina St.; national cuisine, bill ≈600 ₽) — 3.2 from 111 ratings. In Inya: Kechu (4.9), Vkus Altaya (4.8)
reviews: 2GIS: 4.9 (75 ratings, 42 reviews, 2026). Pros: colour contrast, a “place of power”, convenient from the highway. Cons: in summer the effect is weak (samokatus, 07.2025), crowded. Chuy-Oozy petroglyphs — 4.6 (34 ratings, 2GIS).
